_metadata.source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) / Mahavedh (Maha-Agri Weather Network)
_metadata.publisher: India Meteorological Department & Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
_metadata.purpose_in_veya: Used to compute climate risk index, water security for agro-processing & dairy fodder, and seasonal purchasing power volatility.

Pune.monsoon_performance: Adequate Kharif rainfall, good canal and dam storage (Khadakwasla, Kukadi, Manikdoh systems).
Pune.water_security_for_agro: High - Sustained dam irrigation in Junnar/Ambegaon blocks supporting perennial vegetable cycles.
Pune.purchasing_power_cyclicality: Steady post-harvest liquidity peaks in October-December and March-April.

Nashik.monsoon_performance: Favorable in Western Ghat blocks, deficit in eastern blocks (Yeola, Nandgaon); Gangapur & Darna reservoirs adequately filled.
Nashik.water_security_for_agro: Moderate to High - Groundwater recharge adequate for horticultural vineyards and onion storage.
Nashik.purchasing_power_cyclicality: High onion arrival liquidity in January-May.

Ahmednagar.rainfall_category: Normal (Lower boundary of normal band / Rain-shadow zone)
Ahmednagar.monsoon_performance: Dry spells in August; Pravara & Mula canal systems buffered the shortage in canal-irrigated zones.
Ahmednagar.water_security_for_agro: Moderate in Sangamner/Rahuri; requires water conservation techniques like drip irrigation.
Ahmednagar.purchasing_power_cyclicality: Sugarcane and milk procurement provide steady bi-weekly cash flow despite erratic rainfall.

Satara.monsoon_performance: Heavy precipitation in Mahabaleshwar/Patan catchment; Koyna dam filled to 95% capacity.
Satara.water_security_for_agro: Very High along Krishna and Koyna river basins; strong year-round agro and dairy production.
Satara.purchasing_power_cyclicality: Stable year-round cash flow with turmeric/ginger harvesting boost in January-March.

Kolhapur.monsoon_performance: Robust monsoon recharge across Panchganga basin; Radhanagari & Warna dams near full capacity.
Kolhapur.climate_risk_index: Very Low (Excess flood risk in low-lying riverbeds in July-August)
Kolhapur.water_security_for_agro: Excellent - perennial water availability for sugarcane, paddy, and fodder cultivation.
Kolhapur.purchasing_power_cyclicality: High cash velocity driven by weekly cooperative dairy disbursements and sugarcane FRP installments.
